scope: Local integrated component tests; no browser or production performance claim

load_cases.name: closed audit performs no reads or row rendering across normal report polling
opening audit reads once, closed rows disappear, and its manual refresh is independent
audit failure keeps a successful financial report and its saved date visible
hidden pages pause context and report polls and resume one read
offline pages pause context and report polls and resume one read
initial hidden entry waits for visibility and connectivity before reading
initial offline entry waits for visibility and connectivity before reading
a slow context read cannot overlap recurring polls
a slow report read cannot overlap visible recurring polls
mutation refresh waits for one pending read and rejects its older report revision
closing and reopening pending audit never overlaps requests or displays closed-generation rows
actor change immediately removes old content and ignores an old-scope response
changed server session scope ignores a pending report from the earlier context
an earlier actor context response cannot replace the new actor scope
